samples.label: B32. Number of home fires/imminent risk of fire by smoke detector activation, house type, fire spread, area of origin, region and year
samples.source: Swedish Civil Defence and Resilience Agency
note:
Fires attended by the municipal fire and rescue service where the initiating event was fire/imminent risk of fire in building, economic activity was normal residence and house type was block of flats, detached, semi-detached, terraced or summer house. All information as assessed by fire officer.
